$schema_note: Hand-curated record of the list the game's own Angelic roll (DropItemAngelicChance) picks its unique from, and the stand-in entries ForgePact #74 adds to it for the length of one roll while Headhunter's or Tyrant's Crown's panel switch is on. The mechanism, in words, is docs/RUNTIME_DATA_MODELS.md section 13.4 and ForgePact/docs/angelic-roll-hook-research.md section 'Session 3: list injection (issue #74)'. No model or generator reads this file: tests/test_sdk_all.py checks only that curated/ is tracked, and the #74 workorder's acceptance criteria read controller_object, list_variable, reach, typing, game_build and measurements. list_variable stays null until #74's Live 1 measures the variable's name (it could not be recovered statically) and its reach check passes; reach, typing and game_build are the three questions that session answers, each 'not established' until it has run, and are filled by #74's Live 1 with pass, fail or not-observed; measurements is filled from that session's capture, one entry per check, in the style of relic_pick_measurements.json. Static readings below are our own words from a local reading of the game, never its text.
list_entry_shape: array of three numbers [type, sub, b], resolved by GetUniqueRepoStruct(type, sub, b)

repository.bounds: GameMaker's own array bounds checks: an out-of-range triple raises the runtime's array error rather than missing quietly, so only triples ForgePact's validated pool accepted are ever added

Tyrant's Crown.chosen_by: default until the owner names one: the validated type 0 entry of ForgePact's kAngelicBases with the lowest droprate.base, picked when the pool is built and named in the switch-on log line

static_reading.source: local Ghidra project (bare script names), planning session of workorder forgepact-74-angelic-list-injection; nothing decompiled is kept in this repository
claims: The roll reads its unique list as a variable of an object-scoped reference whose constant encodes object index 984, Controller_obj: the variable of the first active Controller_obj instance.
The earlier negatives (no lootListUnique global, no lootListUnique instance variable on Loot_Manager_obj) asked the wrong scopes; they say nothing about the list itself.

The variable's name was not recovered: FindSlotNames, SlotRefs, FindPointers and FindRvaTable each found 0 hits for the slot globals, so the name is read live, by shape (an array whose entries are arrays of three numbers).

The same list slot is also read by DropUniqueItems, DropItemHeroic, DropItemDebug, DropItem, the traveling merchant and black market grids, ReturnRandomSatanic, CreateShrineEffect, DoCraftResult and several unnamed object events; who builds it, and whether per zone or per load, is not established.

GetUniqueRepoStruct(type, sub, b) indexes a global three-level array repo[type][sub][b] with bounds checks; sub is 0 for the unique repository and b the unique's own index (Liquor Holster {8, 0, 51}).
The picker re-picks while the definition's base-info flag 40 is set or its rarity field 27 is neither 7 nor 10, then hits when a uniform integer up to the definition's rate is below the chance.

On a hit CreateDefaultParams(sub, b, 1.0) builds the parameter struct from its three arguments and one zero-argument builtin; it, LootGroundCreate, CreateLootInFreePos and LootGroundInit read no repository.
CreateItemNew is missing from the import, so whether it looks the unique up by (c, b) is not established.

The built item carries the parameters as itemDefinitionStruct {w, j, b, a, c}; the Custom Forge hook recognises Headhunter and Tyrant's Crown by the selector {t, a, b, c, j} = {8, 777002, 2, 0, 0} and {0, 777001, 7, 0, 0}.

attribution: Design, ForgePact #74 (2026-10-02, replan 1), as the plugin implements it: a hit is typed from the latest GetUniqueRepoStruct(type, sub, b) read inside the roll, accepted only when its sub and b equal CreateDefaultParams' own first two arguments; a hit with no such read is untyped, stays the game's own and is counted in untyped=. A typed hit is a stand-in candidate only when its whole triple [type, sub, b] is the stand-in's, and is the mod item's with probability 1 / (n + 1), n being how often the vanilla list holds that same whole triple (m*k / (n + m*k) with the research build's copies lever).

reach.what: Whether the roll's picker draws the entries the plugin pushes onto Controller_obj.<list_variable>: Live 1's reach check compares standinPicks= (hits whose CreateDefaultParams pair is a stand-in's) per hit with the switch off and with angelicprobe inject copies 200, in the same session. The held read-back shows only that the variable holds the push, not that the roll reads it.
reach.source: ForgePact #74 Live 1 (not yet run); ForgePact/docs/angelic-roll-hook-research.md Session 3, Live procedure 3

typing.what: Whether the latest GetUniqueRepoStruct read inside the roll before CreateDefaultParams is the picked entry's: Live 1's typing check reads untyped= and, on vanilla hits, the built item's itemType against the read's type (typeAgree= / typeDisagree=). That the roll calls GetUniqueRepoStruct about eight times per roll is measured (Session 1, 2026-09-23); the order pick, read, filters, die, parameters is a static reading.
typing.source: ForgePact #74 Live 1 (not yet run); ForgePact/docs/angelic-roll-hook-research.md Session 3, Live procedure 3

game_build.what: Whether the game builds exactly one item dressed as Headhunter or Tyrant's Crown for each hit attributed to it, from the rewritten CreateDefaultParams struct, in place of the stand-in: Live 1's inject-build check reads ourHits= against built= / crown= / belt= and the ground.
game_build.source: ForgePact #74 Live 1 (not yet run); ForgePact/docs/angelic-roll-hook-research.md Session 3, Live procedure 3
